head.citation-title: Early hydration of Portland cement studied under microgravity conditions
head.abstracts: © 2015 Elsevier Ltd. All rights reserved.Early ettringite formation from an industrial CEM I 42.5 N hydrated for 10 s at terrestrial and micro gravity conditions was studied in the presence and absence of a polycarboxylate (PCE) superplasticizer. The cement produced very tiny hexagonal ettringite crystals (l ∼ 180 nm, d ∼ 250 nm). The microgravity resulted in ∼25% more crystals at slightly higher aspect ratio (1.4 versus 0.8 at 1 g). In the presence of PCE, generally larger ettringite crystals (l ∼ 325 nm, d ∼ 225 nm) were formed. Microgravity seems to hinder the growth of ettringite on the lateral faces.
